example_sentences_in_bangla: সে গালে হাত দিয়ে অবাক হয়ে গেল।
খবর শুনে তার গালে হাত পড়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He put his hand on his cheek in astonishment.
Upon hearing the news, his hand went to his cheek in surprise.
note: This idiom often implies a gesture of disbelief or shock, common in Bengali body language.
